name: Emily Zhang
education: B.S. in Computer Science, University of British Columbia
summary: Android developer with 2 years of experience writing Kotlin against the Android SDK. Comfortable with Coroutines, Room, and Retrofit, but still building UIs with XML views rather than Jetpack Compose and has not yet adopted the MVVM pattern in a team codebase.
strengths: Solid Kotlin and Android SDK fundamentals
Confident with Coroutines and async work
Uses Room for persistence and Retrofit for networking
Ships features reliably in XML-based views
gaps: No Jetpack Compose experience yet; uses XML layouts
Has not applied the MVVM pattern in production
Limited testing and build tooling exposure
resumeText: Android Developer at Northwind Apps, shipping features in Kotlin with XML-based views, backed by Coroutines, Room, and Retrofit. At Crest Mobile I grew from junior into owning screens and API integration. I am currently learning Jetpack Compose and MVVM to modernize my toolkit.
